customManagers.description: Track upstream GitHub releases pinned via `tag:` in each package.yml

packageRules.description: filebrowser tags look like main_2026-02-07-2.57.0 — regex versioning compares by the trailing semver but writes back the full tag (extractVersion would strip it and break the fetch)
zlibrary tags look like v1.0.46-<commit hash> — regex versioning compares by the leading semver but writes back the full tag (extractVersion would strip the hash and break the fetch)
